legal.title: UK261 delay compensation (summary)
points: Covers flights departing a UK airport, and flights arriving in the UK on a UK or EU airline.
Compensation is due when a flight arrives at its final destination 3 hours or more late.
The amount depends on distance: £220 up to 1,500 km, £350 for 1,500 to 3,500 km, £520 over 3,500 km.
Edinburgh to Faro is about 2,100 km, so the £350 band applies.

No compensation is due if the delay was caused by extraordinary circumstances that could not have been avoided, such as severe weather. Routine operational or technical problems are generally not extraordinary.
Compensation is paid in money. Travel vouchers are only allowed with the passenger's signed agreement.
